title: Ambac Financial Group Rebrands as Octave Specialty Group, Inc.
summary: Cirrata Group and Beat Capital Partners Unite Under the Octave Brand as Octave Partners and Octave Ventures, Respectively Ambac Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: AMBC) today announces it has rebranded to Octave Specialty Group, Inc. (“Octave”) , marking the next phase of its transformation into a leading specialty insurance platform. The company will begin trading under its new ticker symbol “NYSE: OSG” on November 20, 2025. Claude LeBlanc, President and CEO, Octave Specialty Group, Inc.
